title: Thaw: free Bartender alternative
caption:
Bartender charges $25 one-time. Thaw tidies up your Mac's menu bar for free 🧊

✅ Hide the icons you don't need, reveal them on hover, click or scroll
✅ Drag and drop to arrange your menu bar items
✅ Search any menu bar item with a hotkey
✅ No subscription, no account, no tracking, 100% free

💻 Mac
ℹ️ The stable Thaw 2 is for macOS 26. macOS 27 gets a beta, and macOS 14–15 use the older Thaw 1 download

Comment "ICONS" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
